reviews.review:
As the sequel to ArmA 2, I expected much, much better. The future aspect of this game is quite appalling, and I wish it was either Modern, WW2, Cold War or Vietnam. The gaming industry is slowly shifting to Modernized and old eras again, and ArmA came out at the time where the demand started to change, so they missed an opportunity with that one.

However, the game itself is a good improvement upon ArmA 2, as the engine is better (but still not amazing) and there are some performance issues when the game begins getting worthwhile.

The Modding Community makes this game relevent. I dont know many people who enjoy the vanilla version, infact I dont know any. The mods, scripts, and missions that have been made are jaw-dropping compared to the vanilla version. The amount of hours of gameplay you can get out of the game with mods significantly make the price worth the money. Exile is one of the funnest modes you can play, its basically a better DayZ, and the customization of servers really make it good.

Overall, the game has its issues, but it is worthwhile once you add Mods into the mix.
7/10

tl;dr, has some issues, and the vanilla is boring, but once mods are added it becomes really good.
